name: E-11b blaster rifle
description: The BlasTech E-11b blaster rifle was an expertly and expensively modified version of the standard issue E-11 blaster rifle used by the Imperial stormtroopers during the Galactic Civil War, which were modeled after the DC-15 series used in the Clone Wars. These weapons were often found in the hands of Rebel troops, namely those in the Battle of Endor.
